name: Slate modules
description: Official modules for Slate CMS. Add your own registry URL under Modules → Sources.

modules.name: Forms
modules.description: Build forms in the dashboard (Content → Forms), place them anywhere with the Form widget in the editor, a Form custom field, the {{form:slug}} template tag or [form slug="…"], and manage every submission in one inbox with email notifications, spam filtering and CSV export.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Site Migration
modules.description: Move an existing website to Slate: content, post types, taxonomies, custom fields, media (auto-optimized), SEO, menus, settings and URLs with automatic redirects, plus an exact mirror of the design. Also keeps old links, asset URLs and form endpoints of the previous site working.
modules.author: Slate

modules.name: Auto CPT Generator
modules.description: Automatically create post types, taxonomies and custom fields — from a live WordPress site, a WordPress export file, a plain-English description (AI) or a JSON spec.
modules.author: Slate
